request_type: bounded official source and history lookup
scope: Existing patched 3FS reference eligibility and declaration limits for namespace unlink small comparison; not three synchronous durable data replicas or a new build

fixed_identity.distinction: The recorded local ARM64 StampedPtr patch is additional to the officially tracked 3FS patches/folly.patch. Neither the existence of the official patch set nor a matching top-level 3FS commit makes this additional local patch upstream.

findings.claim: The pinned Folly StampedPtr implementation stores a 48-bit pointer above a 16-bit stamp and reconstructs the pointer with a signed right shift, extending bit 47 into bits 48 through 63. Its comments assume that canonical form for both x86-64 and ARM64; the runtime round-trip check is a debug check.
Pinned 3FS WRId inherits folly::StampedPtr<void>, packs RDMAPostCtx pointers and decodes them before calling finish in the RDMA completion path.

The retained ARM64/RXE diagnostic reports a successful RDMA completion wr_id 0xb96e7291b8300004, a valid user mapping 0x0000b96e7291b830 and an invalid decoded pointer 0xffffb96e7291b830 followed by SIGSEGV. This is why the recorded scratch patch changes ARM64 decoding to an unsigned shift. The crash was not reproduced in this review.
findings.limitation: A compatibility explanation for the observed address layout, not an upstream guarantee or proof for arbitrary ARM64 virtual addresses. The patch still packs only 48 pointer bits and does not establish tagged-pointer or 52-bit-address compatibility.

findings.claim: Official Folly removed StampedPtr and its test in commit ce666141a95e9091df7ec84c93e50bb3647020fe on 2024-02-08. The commit describes it as unused in Folly outside its own benchmark. This is API removal, not an ARM64 decoder repair.
findings.history_scope: GitHub commits endpoint filtered by folly/experimental/StampedPtr.h, per_page=100, returned eight entries from its 2017 introduction to its 2024 deletion; no intervening ARM64 fix entry was returned. This does not claim all other files or branches have been exhaustively searched.

findings.claim: At retrieval, official 3FS main resolves to the same fixed 22fca04564c7cc230fd8b9523b8b92864e1dad47 commit dated 2026-05-07. Its Folly gitlink remains 1b7cd10340f565d7fa3fd4f78d6faf14605d77b2. The official releases endpoint returned an empty list.
findings.limitation: No newer official main snapshot or published GitHub release was available in these endpoints; this is not a claim about every branch, issue, pull request, unpublished internal build or downstream fork.

findings.claim: The official issue 30 remains open. A 2025-03-02 maintainer comment says their production machines were x86-64 and ARM64 compilation/runtime behavior had not been tested there. This dated comment does not establish current universal ARM64 support or current impossibility.

Simply replacing the pinned Folly with a version after StampedPtr deletion cannot preserve this exact 3FS source dependency API. No verified unmodified official 3FS ARM64/RXE runtime alternative was established by this bounded investigation.
findings.basis: Fixed 3FS WRId source dependency, fixed Folly gitlink, upstream StampedPtr API deletion and retained local failure evidence.
findings.next_boundary: Any replacement-version implementation or build qualification belongs to a separately scoped task; no environment repair or private patch maintenance is proposed here.

allowed_if_actual_namespace_run_qualifie: A limited namespace unlink measurement against patched 3FS 22fca045 with additional ARM64 StampedPtr patch SHA256 6c460875..., naming the exact fixed binaries, topology, mounts, runtime configuration, workload and timing boundary.

Observed namespace functional correctness and operations per second for the fresh fixed small case, if independently evidenced by completed samples, cross-client ENOENT checks, exact identity and normal lifecycle closure.
Exploratory comparative data with preserved failures and explicit fairness, patch and durability limitations.
not_allowed_from_this_review: Unmodified upstream or official-stock 3FS binary qualification.
Official ARM64/RXE support or an upstream fix for the retained StampedPtr crash.
Full DFS performance parity with 3FS or a formal three synchronous durable replicas read/write comparison.
Data/WAL/Meta acknowledgement ordering, power-loss safety, chunk garbage-collection timing or namespace crash durability.
A namespace performance pass solely because official-source inspection or the old patched smoke passed.
declaration_limits.namespace_separation: The pointer compatibility review does not prove or disprove unlink semantics. Namespace admission may be checked as its own bounded runtime task, but it must retain the patched-reference label and must not inherit unproven data durability or general performance qualification.
declaration_limits.formal_acceptance: This report alone does not close G2.25 or change any historical acceptance conclusion.

retrieval.nonessential_search_failure: One gh search/issues query for repo:deepseek-ai/3FS StampedPtr encountered a TLS handshake timeout; no environment mutation or repeated search retry. Direct pinned official source, file history, release and issue endpoints succeeded.
retrieval.sufficiency: Sufficient to establish exact upstream identities, the additional local patch, its observed motivation, upstream API deletion and conservative declaration boundaries. Insufficient to establish a runtime comparator pass or exhaustively rule out every possible official ARM64 solution.
